_comment: The ONLY trades a page may exist or be proposed for. Added 18 Nov 2026 (PM brief seo-trade-pages-1118). The agent cannot read the private records, so this file is how it knows what Streamlined Tech has really built. ONLY PETE ADDS A TRADE HERE (through the Atlas & Website Product Manager and the Build Manager). Never add one from a search result, a demo, a sample screen or an outreach target. The evidence notes name no client: only IPM Enviro and Komplete Engineers may ever be named on the site.
rule: Only Pete adds a trade here.

trades.evidence: Two client apps built for window and door companies (jobs, measuring, fitting, yearly services). Neither client may be named.

trades.testimonial: Eamonn Kennedy, Director, IPM Enviro (approved main quote, word for word)
trades.evidence: A client app in daily use: the technician scans numbered units on a tablet, logs findings, and the visit report writes itself.

trades.testimonial: Ian O'Mahony, Komplete Engineers (approved main quote, word for word)
trades.evidence: A client app in use: quotes, projects, site visits, notes, invoices, certificates and letters from the firm's own templates. The kind of engineering is not stated; do not add one.
A sample collection app built for a laboratory and in field testing: customers mark samples ready, the driver sees pickups on a map in driving order. Say 'we have built', never 'in use at'.

held.why: One client only; a page would point at one firm. Add only when Pete says so.

never_propose: any town, country or sector page made from a template
_never_propose_note: No client app exists for these. The sample screens for car body shops and truck yards come from our own demos, not a client build. They are outreach targets, not pages.
